Commentary.Commentary: That ends game number 31. Bangladesh keep their hopes of a semi-final alive while Afghanistan are fighting hard to avoid the wooden spoon. Tuesday sees another eagerly awaited clash of this World Cup - not the Ashes exactly but a contest of a similar genre. It is Australia against England and it will be exciting to see who becomes the lord of Lord's. Join us on June 25, 2019, at 10.30 am local (0930 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Bangladesh captain, Mashrafe Mortaza, smiles when asked about the crowd. Thanks them from the bottom of his heart. Is not short of words when asked to praise Shakib, calling him as one of the most important players in the team. On Rahim-Shakib's partnership, Mash says that it was short but very important. Praises Tamim and Mahmudullah for their contributions. On the latter's injury, Mashrafe says that there is a week to go before their next match against India, so Mahmudullah will be assessed gradually. On their upcoming games against India and Pakistan, Mortaza says that Bangladesh will give their best and hope for the best.

Afghanistan captain, Gulbadin Naib, says that the India match was a close one but in this one, blames the poor quality of fielding. Adds that they gave away 30-40 runs extra but does not want to take any credit from Bangladesh's batting or Shakib. On Najibullah batting so low down the order, Naib deflects the question, stating that he is an experienced player and can hit the ball long and blames Ikram Ali Khil for not rotating the strike while batting above him. On Afghanistan's journey so far, Gulbadin says that the team has been suffering from injuries which is why they have not been able to perform well consistently.

SHAKIB AL HASAN HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Shakib says that the support for Bangladesh has been great throughout this World Cup as the crowd has been right behind them. On asked what gave him more happiness - 50 or 5-fer, Al Hasan mentions the five wickets made him more happy as it was important but he had to work hard for his half ton too. States Rahim played really well and without him the score would not have been possible. Further adds Tamim's and Mosaddek's contributions were also important. Tells they had to bat well as Afghanistan have got really good spinners. On his good batting form, Shakib says that he does not know how he is playing so well, but he worked hard and was prepared for it and it is paying off. Ends by saying he wants the form to continue in the matches ahead and they have big games coming up, against India and Pakistan.

7th loss in a row for Afghanistan. They equal the record set by Zimbabwe in 1992, becoming the second team to lose 7 straight matches in a single edition of the World Cup. They started nicely with the ball but then took the foot off the hook. Their batting has never come good in this tournament and it did not come good here either. It is sad to see this performance because after the India game, one would have expected a better show than this one. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

Shakib's day. Mushfiqur's day. Bangladesh's day. They get the 2 points they desperately were searching for. The Tigers move to 5th spot, with 7 points in as many games. The day began with Shakib and Rahim keeping Afghanistan at bay with a 61-run stand, with Rahim capping the innings off with a fine 83. And then with the ball, the number 1 all-rounder in the world in this format strut his stuff, taking a 5-fer. Only the second player ever, to score a fifty and take a 5-fer in the same World Cup game. These are also his best ODI figures.
Comprehensive. Victory by 62 runs. Bangladesh have defeated Afghanistan in a clinical fashion and have re-staked their claim for the semi-final spot. Final 4 decided, you say? Think again.

OUT! KABOOM! Saifuddin gets the last one. Shinwari is denied a half ton. Mujeeb swings blindly to this length ball on the stumps. He misses by a long way and the furniture behind is disturbed. BANGLADESH WIN BY 62 RUNS!
Fuller and on off, this is hit to covers.
Safe! Short and outside off, Shinwari looks to pull but the bat vibrates in his hand. He gets a top edge which lands safe in the mid-wicket region. A single taken.
FOUR! That is fiercely struck! Full and on off, Shinwari smashes it back past the bowler who rightly takes his leg out of the way. Shakib runs to his right and dives but fails to stop it.
Full and on middle, this is jammed down to long on. No single taken.
A yorker outside off, Shinwari fails to jam it out.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on for the final rites. 7-0-28-0 so far.
Almost! Back of a length and around off, once again it straightens after pitching. Mujeeb makes room and then looks to block it out but gets beaten.
Outside off, Mujeeb does go after it but gets beaten.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is the last man in for Afghanistan.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! This was always on the cards! Bangladesh a wicket away now. Mustafizur bowls it on a back of a length around off, this straightens. Zadran looks to push at it but the ball straightens, takes the outside edge and goes into the hands of Rahim. The keeper does not put in a confident appeal but the bowler does and the umpire raises the finger.
A slower one, fuller in length and around off, Shinwari looks to play it with a straight bat but the ball jags away and beats the outside edge.
On the stumps, Zadran pushes it to mid off.
Shorter and on middle, Shinwari looks to pull but mistimes it towards deep square leg for one.
A dot to end a brilliant spell by Shakib! He gives it air on off, Zadran strokes it to covers. A standing ovation for him as he takes his cap. A well-deserved one. He ends with figures of 10-1-29-5.
Flatter and on off, Zadran pushes it towards mid off. Covers runs across and stops it.
Shinwari now works it with the angle through square leg for a single.
This is angled into the pads, Shinwari works it to square leg.
On the stumps, this is kept out. Shakib appeals but not sure for what.
Good running! Shinwari plays it with soft hands through mid-wicket and the batters take two.
Back of a length on middle, it is kept out.
Good stop! This is shorter and outside off, Zadran throws his bat at it, it goes off the outside edge towards the widish first slip fielder who makes a good stop diving to his right.
Almost another! This lands around off and slants away. Zadran looks to push at it but gets beaten.
Dawlat Zadran is the new man in. This is going downhill pretty quickly now.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Just as my colleague says that the Fizz is running out of Fizz, he strikes. Mustafizur bowls it short and on middle, Rashid looks to pull. The ball hurries onto him, it hits the higher portion of the bat and lobs to the man at short mid-wicket. Mashrafe takes a dolly. Bangladesh two wickets away now.
This is angled into the batsman, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length on off, this is guided to point for one.

Floats it up on middle, Shinwari looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early, a soft leading edge to point for one. Just the five runs and a wicket from the over, an important wicket. 74 needed in 42.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Rashid Khan walks in next, at number 9. No slouch but the Afghans need a miracle.

OUT! STUMPED! Any guesses who provides the breakthrough when Bangladesh needed one? There could be only one man at the moment, Shakib Al Hasan. What can this guy not do right now? Brilliant with the bat and now a match-winning spell. He gets his fifer. His second in ODIs. Clever bowling! He sees Zadran come down the track and fires it outside off. NZ swings but is beaten by pace. Rahim makes no mistake behind. A good partnership comes to an end, this stand surely got Bangladesh worried a little.
This is on the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Shinwari guides it through point for two.

Top edge but safe! Zadran looks to play the slog sweep, he tries to drag it with the turn from outside off. There is extra bounce though. It takes the top edge and lands in no man's land in the short third man region. One taken.
A low full toss on middle, Zadran hits it through mid-wicket for one. 7 from the over. 79 needed in 48.
Full and on the pads, SS looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.

Slightly short and around off, Zadran plays it late towards short third man for one. Fifty-run stand up between the two. They have revived Afghanistan's hopes here. Still a long way to go. 81 more needed in 50 balls.
A yorker on off, Zadran jams it out towards mid-wicket and this time there is two.
82 needed from 51. Looks like a close finish again for Afghanistan. They will be hoping a positive one this time around.
Into the body of the batsman, Shinwari works it towards the leg side. He plays it with soft hands. The bowler does really well to get to the ball and keep it down to one.
Slower one on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
SIX! First of the innings. Tossed up outside off, Shinwari dances down the track and lofts it up and over the long on fence for a maximum. Is there still life in the game?
Shakib tossed up and gives more flight, the batsman looks to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Zadran drives this flatter one to long on for a single.
Shinwari cuts this flatter one  through point for a single.
Zadran dances down the track to this tossed up delivery and lofts it down to long on and gets a quick single.
Tossed up outside off, Najibullah drives this through mid off for a couple.

POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end. 97 needed. What can Afghanistan do to bring the game alive? Shakib Al Hasan is back on. Can he get a 5-fer? 7-1-10-4 so far.
A couple to end! Full and on middle, Shinwari hits it wide of long on for two.

Howzzat? The umpire shakes his head. This is bowled outside off, Shinwari looks to play the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but the impact is outside off. Hawk Eye suggests the same.
The slower one does not come off nicely! It is short and way down the leg side. Wided.
A yorker on off, this is jammed out through covers for one.
On the fuller side and on off, this is hit to covers.

Overthrow! Seen quite a few today. A yorker on off, this is jammed out towards cover. Zadran is backing up a long way and hence the fielder there has a shy. The fielder backing up does not stop it cleanly and a run is taken.
Slower one outside off, Zadran pushes it down to long on and takes one.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on! His figures till now 5-0-15-0.

RUN OUT missed! Zadran drops this length delivery outside off to cover and sets off for a quick single and the fielder at cover has a shy at the non striker's end but misses it. Had he hit the stumps it could have been close! In the end it's safe for Zadran and Afghanistan.
Rahman bowls an off cutter and Shinwari looks to run it down to third man but cannot connect and the ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Shinwari flicks this off his pads to mid-wicket and crosses over to the other end.
A slower one, Shiwari looks to push this away to the off side without much feet movement and the ball goes past the outside edge and on the bounce to the keeper.
Shinwari defends this length delivery outside off to the off side.
FOUR! Rahman bowls on a length but provides lots of width outside off, Shinwari throws the kitchen sink at it and cuts it through point and the ball crosses the fence in a flash.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Shinwari guides this through point for one.
Now plays the reverse sweep! It is towards point where the fielder fumbles and the batters take one.
FOUR! Hammered! Zadran comes down the track and also makes room, gets to the pitch of it and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Mosaddek Hossain is back!
Full on pads, Shinwari flicks it to mid-wicket and the batsmen take a single.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Shinwari hops and flicks this off his pads to fine leg and takes a couple.
Zadran runs this length delivery outside off to third man and takes a single.
On a length and outside off, Najibullah taps it to covers.
WIDE! Rahman sprays one down leg. Wided by the umpire.
Fuller in length and outside off, Najibullah drives it straight to covers.
Shinwari pushes this fuller length delivery to covers and takes a quick single.
He goes for the reverse sweep not but does not beat the fielder at backward point. Zadran has come out with an attacking approach here. 9 runs and a wicket from the over.
FOUR! Up and over! That is some way to get off the mark. Zadran steps out and hits it over mid on and bags a boundary. Second in the over.
This is worked with the turn through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Swept and swept nicely! On the pads, Shinwari hits it through backward square leg. The fielder in the deep Mithun runs to his right and dives but his effort goes in vain.
On middle, it is hit to mid-wicket.
Najibullah Zadran walks out to bat next.

OUT! Ikram is short! Poor, poor running by him. This is a big mistake. He has literally thrown away a chance to spend some time out in the middle. Hasan bowls this one on middle, Shinwari looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The bowler is appealing as the ball rolls on the leg side. The umpire shakes his head and Ikram in the meantime sets off for a run. Shinwari is not interested. Das picks the ball up from mid-wicket, turns and then fires it at the bowler's end. It looks like Ikram lazily tries to get in. The ball hits the stumps and an appeal follows. The umpire takes it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show that Ikram wasn't lazy, he was avoiding the throw and hence, he does not ground his bat properly which means he is short.
An appeal for a run out has been taken upstairs. Ikram looked like he did not ground his bat. This could be close.
Mehedi Hasan is back!

DRINKS! It is becoming tough for Afghanistan and they would want both Samiullah Shinwari and Ikram Ali Khil to stay till the end. The required rate is creeping up and they need many big overs. On the other hand, Bangladesh need just 5 wickets to win the match. They have kept it very tight till now. Afghanistan need 131 runs in 90 balls to win the match. Also, this is an extended Drinks Break as the Zing bails are not working and the umpires are waiting for the other ones to come out.

FOUR! Educational edge! A welcome boundary for Afghanistan but they need a lot more. This is outside off, Ikram looks to run it down to third man but it goes off the outside edge and to the third man fence.
On the pads, Ikram works it through square leg for one.
A low full toss outside off, Ikram hits it uppishly but well wide of cover for one.
Full and on off, Ikram jams it out to covers.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Bends his back on this one and lands it short. Ikram hops and guides it to point.
Back of a length on off, Ikram keeps it out.
Mustafizur Rahman is back! He has 7 overs left. It keeps getting tougher for Afghanistan.
This is on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one. Singles won't do it for Afghanistan. They need to go big, the run rate needed is above 8.5.
Good length and around off, Ikram pushes it wide of sweeper cover and takes another two.
Shorter in length and outside off, Ikram hits it hard but to point.
This is bowled into the pads, it is worked towards fine leg for two.
Back of a length on off, Ikram guides it to point.
This is angled into the batsman, he works it through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, this is kept out. Another successful over for Shakib.
Very full and on middle, this is hit down to mid on.
Ikram is off the mark as he eases it down to long on for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Ikram Ali Khil is the new man in.

OUT! Afghan holes out! He needed to go for it, he went against the turn and picks the fielder out. Shakib has his fourth. He tosses it up outside off. Afghan looks to play the slog sweep. He does not hit it that well and it goes down the throat of Sabbir Rahman, the sub at deep mid-wicket. Half the side is back in the hut for Afghanistan and chasing this total now seems very difficult. 146 needed in 106.
Mix-up but safe! Flatter and on off, Afghan taps it towards cover. Shinwari is off for a run but is sent back. He makes it in, in time as he wasn't a long way down the wicket.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

Overthrow! This is worked towards mid-wicket and the batsmen take one. Shakib has a needless shy at the non-striker's end. He hits the stumps, the ball deflects away from the fielder backing up and another run is taken.
Another dot! Full and outside off, this is hit to covers.
Once again Mashrafe gets away with a ball on the pads. Afghan flicks but straight to short fine leg.
On a good length around off, the batter pushes it through covers for one.
This is on the pads, it is worked to short fine leg.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back!
Works this with the angle through square leg for one.
On the stumps, this is kept out.
On off, this is kept out.
This is flatter and on middle, the batter works it towards the leg side. He wants a run but is sent back.
Floats it on off, this is kept out.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler who misfields and a run is taken.
Shorter and outside off, the batter looks to cut but misses.
A little too straight, this is flicked through square leg for one.
Fuller and on off, this is hit through covers for one.
Good length on off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and outside off, it is on the slower side. The batter lets it be. The ball bounces in front of Rahim who does not collect it cleanly. A single taken.
Good shot! Full and on off, this is hit past mid off. Long on runs to his left and keeps it down to two.
Another tossed up ball and Shenwari hits it to covers again. An over with two wickets in it.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed to covers.
Shinwari straightaway looks to play the reverse sweep, gets it fine on the off side for two.
Samiullah Shinwari is the new man in at number 6, replacing Nabi.

OUT! TIMBER! Nabi is out of here for a duck! Shakib gets two in three balls. Afghanistan in huge trouble now. The slider does the trick this time. Shakib bowls it from wide of the crease and this starts from outside off, it drifts back in. Nabi plays outside the line, the ball kisses the inside edge and deflects onto the stumps. The crowd here is going bonkers.
On the stumps, this is kept out.
Mohammad Nabi walks in at number 5, replacing his skipper.

OUT! No fifty for Gulbadin! Excellent catch, even more impressive field placement! Also, Shakib bowls to that plan. He has a short cover and a normal cover in place. He gives it extra flight tempting the batsman to drive. Naib does get tempted, he looks to drive but does not keep it down. Das at short cover is low and ready for it and then takes a sharp chance. Naib probably falls at the wrong time for Afghanistan. He was set and they needed him to step on the gas, he was looking to do so but falls before he could make an impact. Bangladesh continue to tighten their grip on the game.
A dot to end as well! A low full toss on off, Afghan strokes it back to the bowler. 159 needed in 132 balls.
A dot now! Back of a length on off, Afghan pushes it to covers.
Length again and around middle, Naib drags it through mid-wicket for another run. Naib looking to step on the gas now.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed out to long on for one.
Back of a length on off, this is guided to point.
Slower one outside off, Naib walks down the track and drags it through mid-wicket for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
You don't often see this in limited overs cricket. Silly point has been drafted in. Liton Das is the man.
Down the leg side, a full toss at that, Naib misses out, aiming to flick. The ball goes towards square leg and Gulbadin wants a single but Afghan sends him back. There was an easy single on offer.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, driven back to the bowler.

Full and around off, driven back to the bowler who leaps to his right and gets a hand to it. Deflects it behind and the ball almost hits umpire Michael Gough who manages to evade it. A run taken to long on. 100 UP FOR AFGHANISTAN. It is a good position to be in, only two wickets down but they need a set batsman to bat through.
On middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on. 2-0-5-0 so far.
Fired in around off, AA looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge towards square leg. A run taken.
Excellent loop, outside off, Asghar initially looks to play a big slog sweep but then the ball never arrives. He has to change his shot, making it a forward defense to the off side.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Outside off, very full, driven back to the bowler.
Fuller in length to start off, watchfully defended.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on. 2-0-2-1 so far.
Full in length, pushed through to long on for another single.
On middle and leg, flicked behind square leg for one.
FOUR! Fine, fine shot. This is what Afghanistan need. Some momentum. Afghan is providing that. At least he is not bottling up the runs.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off again, Afghan reaches out, looks to paddle but gets it off the inner half of the bat. Just eludes a leaping Rahim and goes to fine leg. Two runs taken.
Full and outside off, slogged over mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot. Tossed up outside off, Naib comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Fuller on middle, Afghan gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
LEADING EDGE, SAFE! Full and around middle, Naib looks to flick but gets a leading edge over the bowler down to mid off.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Drives this towards mid off.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Asghar Afghan walks in at number 4, replacing Shahidi.

OUT! STUMPED! Mosaddek gets the second wicket for Bangladesh. Nicely bowled. Flighted outside off, Hashmatullah lunges out to drive but the ball pitches and spins away. Beats the outside edge and Rahim collects nicely, whipping the bails off. It is referred upstairs and replays show that Shahidi has not dragged his foot back in. This does not help Afghanistan. Both batsmen were trying to absorb the pressure but then one of those has not converted his start. 184 more needed from 175 balls.
Stumping appeal! Is that gone? Our colleague Louis is certain the batsman is a goner. It has been referred upstairs and just one replay should be enough. The foot has not come back in.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

RUN OUT MISSED! Mosaddek is not happy. Mortaza is not happy either. Sloppy from Liton Das. Shahidi pushes this towards covers and calls for a single. However, he then changes his mind. Naib has to change track, take a U-turn and when he does so, looks to be gone for all money. Liton Das gets to the ball and returns a wild throw, well away from the stumps, which means Mosaddek has to reach out to his right, collect, turn around and then whip the bails. Naib has dived in by that time. A straighter throw would have had Gulbadin.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
On middle and off, Hashmatullah looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of his bat towards mid on. A run taken.
The passage of singles continues. This one is through mid on.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Outside off, pushed through point for an easy single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, punched towards point.
Outside off, cuts back in sharply, Shahidi looks to cut but mistimes it to point. Rahim thinks that the ball has hit the pad first and appeals for LBW but is not entertained.
A touch short, Shahidi goes back and cuts it straight to point.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Another flick, another single.
Flicks this away for a couple.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
Full and around middle, swept through square leg. Sabbir Rahman runs to his left, the substitute and dives to save the boundary. Three runs taken.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
No slip for a spinner! Strange tactics. Full and outside off, Shahidi looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge, through the vacant slip cordon towards third man. A couple taken.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for one more.
Full and outside off, Shahidi drives it through mid off for a single.
Landed outside off, dabbed to short third man.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Naib may be suffering from cramps! The physio is out and some stretching is going on. In the meantime, the umpires have called for DRINKS! Afghanistan are going at a steady rate but would want to step up. They have lost just one wicket and would want this partnership going. On the other hand, Bangladesh have kept it tight and would want quick wickets to put pressure on Afghanistan. Afghanistan need 203 runs in 204 balls to win the match.
Loopy delivery on middle, the skipper nudges it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated delivery on middle, Naib plays it to mid on off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Shahidi sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Floated delivery on middle, Shahidi keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on off, Shahidi plays it to point.
Tossed up on off, Shahidi defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Releases the pressure somewhat! Naib comes down the track and lofts it over mid off and bags a boundary. Picks his spot nicely there.
5 dots! Once again it is on the pads, Naib works it to mid-wicket.
On the stumps again and Naib works it to mid-wicket.
Quicker and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Floats it up on off, the batter hits it to cover.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed to mid-wicket.
Mosaddek Hossain is into the attack.

Sharp turn! Brilliantly bowled! This is flatter and just around off, the length is the one in which the batsman is not sure whether to come forward or stay back. Shahidi goes back and looks to defend. The ball spins away and beats the outside edge.
Floats it up on middle, Naib strokes it down to long on for one.
On middle, Naib works it with the turn to mid-wicket.

A run out chance goes abegging! Fuller and on middle, this is worked towards mid on. Shahidi sets off but Naib is ball watching. He then realizes his partner wants a run and sets off. Mashrafe gets to the ball quickly but can't keep his balance. Had he done so, it could have been close.
A single as Naib pushes it down to long on.
On the stumps, this is kept out.
Another dot as Shahidi pushes it back to the bowler. The spinners are choking the runs here.
Flatter and on off, Shahidi guides it to point.
Floats it up on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
This is on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

Well played and well stopped! This is on off, it straightens after pitching. Naib covers the spin by opening the face of the bat. It goes towards backward point where the fielder makes a good stop diving to his left. A single taken.
The arm ball on middle, Naib defends it.
Another dot to end! Back-to-back good overs for Bangladesh! This is flatter and on middle, HS works it to mid-wicket.
Sees the batsman coming down the track and fires it on the stumps, it is kept out.
Flatter and on off, Shahidi prods forward and keeps it out.
Outside off, Naib opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point for one. 50 up for Afghanistan.
On the pads, this is worked to square leg.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked towards square leg.
Mehedi Hasan is on now! Spin from both ends.

BREAKING NEWS - Andre Russell has been ruled out of the tournament due to a knee injury. Sunil Ambris has been called up as his replacement. How will that affect West Indies' chances, if they had any?
Floats it up on middle, this is defended. A brilliant first over by Shakib comes to an end. Just the run and a wicket from it.
Hashmatullah Shahidi is the new batsman in.

OUT! In the air... caught! Shakib strikes straightaway and provides the much-needed breakthrough. This is slightly shorter but quicker. Rahmat goes back and looks to pull but the ball hurries onto him. A top edge is induced which lobs towards mid on. Tamim takes a good catch running backwards. Shah walks back after getting off to a start. This is a good wicket as Rahmat is one of Afghanistan's best batters. 214 needed in 235 balls.
Rahmat dances down the track and strokes it to covers. Another dot.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
Shorter and outside off, Shah slaps it to covers.
Floats it up on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Shakib Al Hasan is on now!
Powerplay 2 begins! No more than 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

Full on middle, Shah drives it back towards the bowler where Saifuddin in return throws it back towards Rahim. A very good Powerplay 1 for Afghanistan. They are 48/0. Afghanistan need 215 runs in 240 balls.
Length delivery on middle, Naib flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length on off, Naib plays it to mid off.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Naib looks to cut but misses it.
Full on middle, Naib drives it to mid on.
On a length on middle, Naib flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
A dot to end but a lovely over for Afghanistan! Full and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beauitful shot! Lovely to the eyes! Slightly shorter and around off, Shah waits for it and then just guides it through cover-point.
Over the fielder! Slower one and fuller in length. Naib mistimes his loft. There are shouts of catch it but it clears mid on. Tamim runs back and fields it before the ropes. The batsmen take three.
Length and around off, this is guided down to third man for one.
That is an absolute jaffa! Unplayable! This lands around off and then straightens. Rahmat does nothing wrong as he plays the original trajectory but the away movement beats the outside edge.
FOUR! Good start to the over! Short and on the body, Shah swivels and pulls it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Poor ball with fine leg up.
A good first over by MS! Length ball around middle, this is pushed to mid off.
Why was Zazai dropped? If there's one attack he can dominate with his no footwork, it is Bangladesh's.
Naib misses out there! This is on the pads, GN looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls to short fine leg.
Slower one on off, Naib pushes it to mid off.
Slightly fuller and on middle, Rahmat works it through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, this is worked to deep square leg for one.
This is angled into the batsman, Naib looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. He gets a soft leading edge to point.
Mohammad Saifuddin is on now!
This is angled onto the pads, Shah flicks but to mid-wicket.
Length again and on middle, Shah slaps it to mid on. He may be looking to go after Mortaza.

Up and over! You just need to clear the in-field in the first 10 overs. Shah dances down the track and Mash bowls it on a length. Shah swings but does not get it off the middle. He hits it well enough to clear mid on and two taken.
This is on the pads, Shah looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pads.
A couple now! This is on the pads, Shah works it over mid-wicket and takes an easy two.
Back of a length and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! First sign of intent from Afghanistan and Naib! Rahman bowls it full and on middle, Naib clears his front leg and hits it over mid off. It is not off the middle but trickles over the fence. Rahman's last ball once again spoils the over.
Good length and on off, Naib pushes it to mid off.
This is shorter in length, Rahmat waits for it and then guides it down to third man for one.
BEATEN! That is exactly what the Fizz wants the batsman to do. This is full and outside off, Shah throws his bat at it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Good running! This is fuller and on off, Naib pushes it towards mid off and gets to the other end.
BEAUTY! This lands on a length around off and then moves away. Naib looks to defend but is beaten by the away movement.
A good nut to end a good over! Length and around off, Shah looks to push at it away from the body, he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On a length around off, Rahmat lunges and defends it to covers.
Continues bowling it on a length and around off, Shah stands tall and keeps it out.
Another back of a length ball on middle, Shah defends it onto the ground.
Fuller and on the pads, Naib flicks it uppishly but well short of deep square leg for one.
Back of a length and on middle, Naib pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! That has been nailed! First boundary off the bat! Rahman goes short and on middle, Shah goes back quickly and pulls it over the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Another back of a length ball, Shah stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length and on off, Shah goes back and defends it.
Good length again and just outside off, Shah lets it be.
Solid defense! On a length and around off, Shah lunges and keeps it out.
Another leg bye! On the pads again, Naib looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.

A couple to end! A good punch shot! Rahmat stands tall and pushes this back of a length delivery down the ground. Saifuddin runs after it from mid on. He slides and looks to parry but fails in the first attempt. Does so in the second but Tamim does not collect it cleanly. Still only two taken.

Well bowled! Mashrafe bowls an off cutter. It pitches and then jags back in. Shah looks to defend being half-forward. The ball though kisses the inside edge and goes on the bounce to the keeper who makes another half-stop but this time no runs taken.
Back of a length on off, Naib pushes it wide of mid on and gets to the other end.
Once again Mash lands it on a length around off, this is blocked.
Another ball on a good length. Shah looks to defend but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
Angled into the body, this is worked through square leg for one.

NOT OUT! Shah is well in! This is down the leg side, Rahmat fails to flick it. The ball bounces just ahead of Rahim. He does not collect it cleanly. The batters go for a run. The fielder from square leg runs in, picks the ball up and hits bull's eye at the non-striker's end. They appeal. The umpire first signals it as a wide and then takes it up. Replays roll in and they show Shah is fine.
A direct hit and the umpire has taken it upstairs. No Bangladesh player seems excited.
Back of a length on middle, Naib stands tall and keeps it out.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor ball and a boundary! On the pads, Naib looks to flick but misses, it brushes the pads and races to the fine leg fence. First boundary of the chase comes via leg byes!
The Fizz goes full again on off, Naib strokes it to covers.
Back of a length and on middle, Gulbadin goes back and pushes it to mid on.
On the fuller side and outside off, Naib strokes it to mid off.

A little shape back in! This starts around middle and then tails back in. Naib looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. The bowler makes an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Right decision as Ball Tracking shows it to be pitching outside leg.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl with the second new ball.
A dot to end! Length and around off, Rahmat guides it to point. Two good balls to end.
On the fuller side around off, Shah is guilty of going too hard at it, he gets an inside edge onto his pads.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Shah looks to flick but misses. It has been wided. Mortaza has been a little too straight.
This is a little too straight, Shah works it through mid-wicket, wide of the fielder in the deep and two is taken.
Good length and on off, Shah keeps it out.

Afghanistan are underway! This is bowled on the pads, Naib looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes to the keeper. Rahim dives to his left and makes a half-stop. Saves three for his side. Leg bye taken.
Back of a length and on off, Naib stands tall and keeps it out.
We are back for the chase! Gulbadin Naib and Rahmat Shah are the openers for Afghanistan. Mashrafe Mortaza has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
